rule: Choose smallest browser-working candidate with >=95% adapted float32 PyTorch top-move agreement and at most 2 fewer teacher bestmove hits; otherwise FP16 storage if eligible, else float32 reference.
reference: float32 PyTorch adapted checkpoint on the validation FEN and its python-chess legal moves
teacherHit: Top candidate equals the first validation teacher move when present
tieBreak: Descending expected value, then ascending UCI string
repetitionOverride: Fivefold repetition or claimable threefold repetition scores exactly 0.5
finalTest: Not used for selection; previously exposed historical 147-position test is not a fresh held-out estimate.
